title: Smart Shulker Deposit+
description: Quickly deposit matching items into Shulker Boxes with Shift + Right Click, featuring smart item previews, visual popups, and safe inventory handling.
body:
# Smart Shulker Deposit+

**Smart Shulker Deposit+** is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that makes Shulker Box storage faster, cleaner, and easier.

With **Shift + Right Click**, you can instantly deposit matching items from your inventory into a placed Shulker Box. The mod checks what items are already inside the Shulker Box and only moves matching item types, keeping the system safe, predictable, and vanilla-friendly.

## How it works

Place a Shulker Box, put at least one item type inside it, then use **Shift + Right Click** on the Shulker Box.

For example, if a Shulker Box already contains cobblestone, dirt, and oak logs, the mod will move matching cobblestone, dirt, and oak logs from your inventory into that Shulker Box. Other items stay untouched.

## Features

* **Smart matching deposit** – only deposits items that already match the contents of the Shulker Box.
* **Shift + Right Click support** – no commands, menus, or extra items required.
* **Inventory and hotbar support** – works with both main inventory and hotbar slots.
* **Safe active slot handling** – helps avoid accidentally moving the item stack you are currently using.
* **Clean item preview popup** – shows deposited item icons, item names, and moved amounts.
* **Multiple item preview** – displays several item icons when multiple item types are deposited.
* **Full Shulker warning** – clearly tells you when the Shulker Box is full.
* **No matching items message** – shows a clean warning when there are no matching items to deposit.
* **Happy and angry Shulker reactions** – small particle and sound effects for successful deposits or full boxes.
* **Lightweight and vanilla-friendly** – improves storage management without changing the core Minecraft feel.

## Supported Version

* Minecraft **1.20.1** – Forge

Smart Shulker Deposit+ is made for players who want faster Shulker Box management, cleaner inventory handling, and a smoother storage experience without using large inventory overhaul mods.
